item.text: The first comparison shows that the leaf and barrel need to sit on the opposite sides of the model axes. I’ll correct that orientation and refine the barrel spacing and mounting holes. The [live model](http://127.0.0.1:8773/#part.FCStd) is available to inspect.

item.text: The revised model reaches a 96.3% mean silhouette match across the four views. It has two hollow barrel sections and two countersunk mounting holes. I’ll make a small final barrel-position adjustment, verify it, and export the single solid.
